title: ConnectionConfig
description: JSON configuration for one core.connections.ConnectionConfig, as parsed by core/connections/config.py:ConnectionConfig.from_json. Validate a config file with: python -c "import json,jsonschema; jsonschema.validate(json.load(open('myconfig.json')), json.load(open('core/configs/connection.schema.json')))"
$comment: unitCode is required under ANY ONE of its three spellings (config.py UNIT_CODE_KEYS) -- it is THIS process's own wire identity, not a per-unit code.

protocol.description: Transport for this connection. Drives which protocol-specific extra keys apply and whether 'topics' (dds-only) or the echo keys (rejected on dds) are legal.

side.description: Role this connection plays. tcp: client/server. udp/multicast: sender/receiver (also used as the default direction for multicast, and as the config.side default for dds topics without an explicit 'direction'). dds: publisher/subscriber.

ip.description: Remote/target address. For tcp client or udp/multicast sender: the peer to dial. For tcp/udp server: the bind address. For dds: unused by the transport (RTI discovery handles addressing) but still required.

local_ip.description: Local bind address. Alias: 'localIp'. Defaults to '0.0.0.0' if omitted.

unitCode.description: THIS connection's OWN unit code -- required, stamped into every outgoing message header so peers know who sent it. Aliases: 'UnitCode', 'unit_code'. NOT the same thing as connections[name].unitCode (that is the REMOTE unit's code).

connections.description: REQUIRED. Single source of truth for unit routing: maps each logical unit name to where it lives and how it identifies itself. There is no implicit/default unit and no separate port list.

topics.description: DDS ONLY. The list of DDS topics this connection publishes/subscribes. Required (and must be non-empty) when protocol is 'dds'; rejected (must be absent/empty) on every other protocol.

echo_opcode.description: One opcode used for BOTH heartbeat directions (symmetric echo). Aliases: 'EchoOpcode', 'echoOpcode'. Accepted at the connection level (shared default) and inside a connections[name] entry (per-unit override, whole opcode GROUP overrides the shared default). Not legal on protocol 'dds'.

recv_echo_opcode.description: Inbound heartbeat opcode, for peers that heartbeat asymmetrically. Aliases: 'RecvEchoOpcode', 'recvEchoOpcode'. Both recv and send must resolve for echo to be enabled on a unit. Not legal on protocol 'dds'.

send_echo_opcode.description: Outbound heartbeat opcode, for peers that heartbeat asymmetrically. Aliases: 'SendEchoOpcode', 'sendEchoOpcode'. Not legal on protocol 'dds'.

echo_interval.description: Seconds between outbound echoes. Aliases: 'EchoInterval', 'echoInterval'. Default 1.0. Must be strictly less than the (resolved) echo timeout.

echo_timeout.description: Seconds of silence before a unit is declared dead and dropped. Aliases: 'EchoTimeout', 'echoTimeout'. Default 5.0. Must be strictly greater than the (resolved) echo interval.

Structures.description: IRS structures module(s) for this link, as a connection-level default. Alias: 'structures'. Only legal when there is exactly ONE entry in 'connections' -- OR on protocol 'multicast', where one sender fans out to many receivers over a shared IRS. Otherwise each unit must declare its own 'Structures' inside connections[name].

ttl.description: MULTICAST ONLY. Multicast TTL / hop limit. Default 1 (stay on the local subnet).

mode.description: UDP ONLY. Restricts direction on a plain UDP link so it can stand in for a directional multicast link in test setups. Default 'duplex'.

idl_modules.description: DDS ONLY. Python module(s) of @idl.struct classes to import -- by dotted module path or filesystem path. A single string is accepted as a one-element list. Alias: 'idl_file'.

idl_file.description: Alias of 'idl_modules' (checked only when 'idl_modules' is absent).

qos_file.description: DDS ONLY. Path to the QoS profile XML (e.g. 'core/configs/qos/UNIVERSAL_QOS.xml').

qos_profile.description: DDS ONLY. Qualified QoS profile name within qos_file (e.g. 'MyLib::Reliable').

header.description: DDS ONLY. Configures where routing fields live inside each sample.

field.description: Name of the nested struct field holding the header, or null if the routing fields sit at the sample's top level. Default: framework's DEFAULT_HEADER_FIELD.

source_unit.description: Field name (inside the header) carrying the sending unit's code. Default: DEFAULT_SOURCE_FIELD.

destination_unit.description: Field name (inside the header) carrying the destination unit's code. Default: DEFAULT_DESTINATION_FIELD.

stamp.description: Whether outgoing samples get source/destination stamped automatically. Default true.

$comment: additionalProperties stays true: 'extra' is an intentionally open catch-all (config.py _split_extra) for protocol-specific keys not enumerated above and for forward-compatible additions.

then.$comment: DDS DataWriters can't carry the echo lifecycle's raw-bytes heartbeat; use DDS LIVELINESS QoS instead (see config.py _reject_echo_on_dds).

else.$comment: 'topics' is a DDS concept; on a socket protocol its presence can only be a mistake (see config.py _reject_topics_on_non_dds).

unitCode.description: UInt8 unit code (0-255). Decimal or hex-string ('0x1A') are both accepted by the loader; this schema requires a JSON integer.

opcode.description: UInt16 opcode (0-65535). Decimal or hex-string ('0x0A') are both accepted by the loader; this schema requires a JSON integer.

structures.description: One structures spelling, or a list of them. A dotted module name (must live under core/IRS/Structures/) or a filesystem path to a .py file anywhere on disk.

unitEndpoint.description: One entry of 'connections': where a remote unit lives, its own wire identity, and its echo/Structures overrides.
unitEndpoint.$comment: 'port' must be spelled exactly 'port' (config.py PORT_KEY, case-sensitive) -- unlike unitCode/Structures/echo keys it has no accepted alias, so 'Port'/'ports' are silently NOT read as the port.

port.description: Transport port this unit is reached on. For DDS, the domain id -- every unit sharing one DdsConnection must use the SAME port/domain id.

unitCode.description: THIS unit's (the remote peer's) wire identity. Required; must be unique among all units in this 'connections' map. Aliases: 'UnitCode', 'unit_code'.

echo_opcode.description: Per-unit override of the connection-level echo_opcode (whole opcode group overrides). Set explicitly to null to opt this unit OUT of echo even though the connection has a default.

recv_echo_opcode.description: Per-unit override of the connection-level recv_echo_opcode.

send_echo_opcode.description: Per-unit override of the connection-level send_echo_opcode.

echo_interval.description: Per-unit override of EchoInterval (resolves individually, not as a group).

echo_timeout.description: Per-unit override of EchoTimeout (resolves individually, not as a group).

Structures.description: This unit's own IRS structures module(s) -- takes priority over the connection-level default.

topic.description: DDS topic name on the wire. Alias: 'Topic' (also 'name', lowest priority).

name.description: Fallback alias of 'topic', lowest priority of the three.

type.description: Name of the @idl.struct class carrying this topic. Alias: 'Type'.

type_name.description: Overrides the DDS wire type name (otherwise the Python class name). Aliases: 'typeName', 'TypeName'. Use when talking to a peer whose type was generated from IDL under a different name.

direction.description: Which DDS entities this topic gets. Alias: 'Direction'. Defaults from the connection's 'side' when omitted (publisher/sender -> publish, subscriber/receiver -> subscribe, else both).

opcode.description: Local-only routing surrogate for this topic (never sent on the wire). Aliases: 'opCode', 'OpCode'. Auto-derived from the topic name (blake2s hash) if omitted; set explicitly only to resolve a collision between two topic names that hash the same.
